reasoning.Student A: Given my preferences (x > y > w > z) and the information that most applicants prefer y > x > w > z, I should propose to my most preferred school, x. If I propose to y, I risk being rejected in favor of someone who also strongly prefers y, and then being left with a less desirable option later. Proposing to x now is a direct attempt to get my best outcome.
